findings.why: BK-330 (PRG-Z, Aurelia) would change coating from COAT-ZNNI to COAT-ZNFLAKE. The meeting relied on revision 3, clause 7.2 (notification only), but revision 4 replaces it. Under 7.1 of revision 4 a coating change needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment. Revision 4 also requires 90 days' notification. No approval is in the documents, so the change cannot ship on notification alone.
